Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

number — a word or sign for a quantity. Example: My phone number is here.
ten — the number 10. Example: There are ten people.
twenty — the number 20. Example: My flat number is twenty.
thirty — the number 30. Example: It costs thirty euros.
hundred — the number 100. Example: It costs a hundred euros.
count — to say numbers in order. Example: Count from one to ten.
price — how much something costs. Example: The price is good.
age — how old someone is. Example: My age is thirty.
phone number — the number of your telephone. Example: My phone number is zero seven nine.
zero — the number 0. Example: My number starts with zero.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• It costs ...
• I am ... years old.
• My phone number is ...
• There are ... people.
• It is number ...
